Title: Cock Robin + Jack of Both Sides

Messages.Author: js_vtes
Messages.Body:
A couple questions...

1. If Cock Robin uses Jack of Both Sides to employ a Raptor (or whatever Animalism retainer strikes his fancy), does that count as an "action that requires Animalism" for the purposes of his untap ability?

2. Say you have two Raptors and a Jack of Both Sides in your hand. Can Cock Robin take a normal employ retainer action to get one, untap with his ability, then play JoBS to get the second?

Thanks!

Cock Robin

Group: 3
Camarilla Nosferatu Justicar: Once per turn, when Cock Robin successfully performs an action that requires Animalism  , he untaps at the end of the action. +1 strength.

Jack of Both Sides

[1 Blood]
+2 stealth action. Requires a ready vampire.
This vampire equips or employs an equipment or retainer from your hand. The cost of that card is reduced by 1 pool or by up to 2 blood.

Messages.Author: kschaefer
Messages.Body:
> js_vtes wrote:
> 1. If Cock Robin uses Jack of Both Sides to employ a Raptor (or whatever Animalism retainer strikes his fancy), does that count as an "action that requires Animalism" for the purposes of his untap ability?
>
No. The action is Jack of Both Side, which is disciplineless.

> js_vtes wrote:
> 2. Say you have two Raptors and a Jack of Both Sides in your hand. Can Cock Robin take a normal employ retainer action to get one, untap with his ability, then play JoBS to get the second?
>
Yes. Since the first action is Raptor and the second action is Jack of Both Sides. Cock Robin is not prevented by NRA.

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
Correct.
